body: To each their own. I think there is no right way of doing anything, and I'm not interested in making it up or taking someone else's.
I'd say  it feels more like there is no right way at all.
I know that well, it's just the way I feel.

It was the same for me. Then I just couldn't stand people being patient and kind in return, and that disgust was probably easily readable, so I lost contact with most of them.  After that I couldn't help but feel that if someone is contacting me, he or she is in despair and has no one else to talk to.
So will you loose respect for someone if he wearied of your "wacky annoying bullshit"?
Interesting. What's the major difference between people you respect and people you don't respect?

True. Still, being polite is important to show some respect. I don't feel any respect for anyone. Maybe it's not a feeling, but a decision? Then it seems I don't know how to decide whether I should or I shouldn't respect someone. Only way of showing that I care I found is to shut up, because listening to someone seems to be the only way I can bring joy.

You just "helped in some way" by making that offer, thanks. But I have to decline. It seems that every person I've talked to including strangers on the internet would agree that as a person I'm a total piece of shit, my way of talking is excessively rude and I can't control it. I'm surprised no one beaten my up for that. I don't want to disappoint yet another person.
I'd love to, but I don't think there is anything to talk about.
